role_summary: Designs how products look, feel and flow: user research, wireframes, prototypes, visual and interaction design, and design systems.

postings.title: Early Career, Product Designer
postings.location: San Francisco, CA / New York, NY, USA
postings.summary: Early-career product designer owning features end to end, from flows and prototypes to high-fidelity visuals, alongside engineering.
responsibilities: Own feature design from start to finish
Identify user and business needs with product and research
Create flows, prototypes and high-fidelity visuals
Work with engineering on high-quality implementation
requirements: Demonstrated visual and/or interaction design skill
Experience shipping projects with strong product thinking
Ability to express ideas through prototypes or code
Interest in design tools and design systems
